world.title: US, China must ensure to develop AI that's under human control: Xi Jinping at White House
world.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping emphasized the need for US-China cooperation on artificial intelligence, urging that its development remains under human control and serves public welfare. He advocated for managed competition, regular military communication, and a new approach to bilateral relations, despite ongoing strategic differences. Xi's remarks highlighted the importance of AI safety in the context of global challenges.

world.title: At least 30 arrested, including actors, politicians during anti-Netanyahu protest outside UN
world.summary: Police arrested over 30 individuals, including actors and politicians, during a protest against Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu outside the United Nations headquarters on Thursday. The demonstration coincided with the UN General Assembly, where participants voiced their opposition to Netanyahu's policies. The arrests highlight ongoing tensions surrounding Israeli governance and international diplomatic discussions.

world.title: Pakistan Carrying Out Afghan Strikes To Exit Mecca Pact With Saudi Arabia, Turkey: Taliban
world.summary: Taliban spokesman Zabihullah Mujahid accused Pakistan of conducting strikes in Afghanistan to manipulate the narrative and evade obligations under the Mecca Pact with Saudi Arabia and Turkey. Mujahid claimed Islamabad is framing the situation as a conflict with Afghanistan, suggesting that these actions are intended to justify its departure from commitments made in the agreement.

business.title: White House state dinner: Trump welcomes Xi as tech bosses, top executives arrive
business.summary: US President Donald Trump and First Lady Melania Trump hosted Chinese President Xi Jinping and his wife, Peng Liyuan, at the White House for a state dinner. The event, attended by tech leaders and top executives, aimed to strengthen US-China relations. The dinner highlighted ongoing discussions on trade and technology between the two nations amid rising tensions.

business.title: 5 Energy Stocks Positioned for a Prolonged Iran War
business.summary: JPMorgan indicates uncertainty in the oil market due to the ongoing Iran war, which is affecting energy sectors. Higher crude prices, record refining margins, LNG shortages, and increased shipping costs are creating profit opportunities. The bank no longer has a clear baseline for market recovery, diverging from previous assumptions about the impact of rising oil prices on the economy.

business.title: South Indian Bank, Allied Blenders and Distillers Vishal Mega Mart, Medanta, Caplin Point Laboratories
business.summary: Market experts are advising the purchase of five stocks: South Indian Bank, Global Health, Allied Blenders and Distillers, Caplin Point Laboratories, and Vishal Mega Mart. These recommendations include entry levels, price targets, and stop-losses for traders, with potential gains projected up to 36%. The stocks span sectors including banking, healthcare, beverage manufacturing, and consumer services.

technology.title: I went hands-on with the Xiaomi 18 Pro phones, and they bring two very cool display features I wish were on every Android phone
technology.summary: Xiaomi has launched its flagship 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max smartphones in China, featuring the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 processor. During the Snapdragon Summit in Maui, hands-on experiences highlighted two notable display features that could enhance Android devices. These phones represent a significant advancement in performance and technology within the smartphone market, showcasing Xiaomi's innovation.

technology.title: Oppo K14 Plus teaser confirms September 29 launch with 8000mAh battery, 144Hz 1.5K display, 5000 mm² VC cooling
technology.summary: Oppo will launch the K14 Plus in India on September 29. The mid-range smartphone features an 8000mAh battery, a 144Hz 1.5K display, and 5000 mm² VC cooling. It is powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 7360 Max processor, with 8GB of RAM and 256GB of storage. This expansion continues Oppo's K-series offerings in the Indian market.

technology.title: Google's new Gemini Live Avatars want to make support bots feel more human
technology.summary: Google is launching Gemini 3.8 Live with Avatar, introducing lip-synced, multilingual video agents for customer support. This feature combines real-time video generation with speech models, allowing the avatars to engage more naturally. Live Avatars can also trigger tool calls and retrieve data while conversing, aiming to enhance user interaction and make support bots feel more human-like.

sports.title: Asian Games 2026 Live Updates, Day 7: India's Manush-Diya confirm mixed doubles table tennis medal; Suruchi-Kamaljeet qualify for 10m air pistol mixed team final; badminton scores
sports.summary: On Day 7 of the 2026 Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya, India's Manush and Diya secured a medal in mixed doubles table tennis. Additionally, Suruchi and Kamaljeet qualified for the 10m air pistol mixed team final. The event continues to provide updates on medal tallies, results, schedules, and highlights as competition progresses.

sports.title: Know India scores, updates and results from Day 6
sports.summary: On Day 6 of the Asian Games 2026, India saw significant action in athletics, badminton, and shooting. Notably, Kamaljeet and Suruchi Inder Singh qualified for the 10m air pistol mixed team final, topping the qualification round with a score of 587-29x. Updates on scores, results, and medal winners were provided throughout the day.

sports.title: England hamstrung in chase as Kusal class lifts Sri Lanka
sports.summary: Jos Buttler's hamstring issue significantly impacted England's performance, leading to a decisive series match against Sri Lanka at The Oval. Kusal Mendis' return has strengthened Sri Lanka, showcasing his class in the series. The match highlights the importance of player fitness, with Buttler's injury creating challenges for England as they aim to secure a win in the series decider.

health.title: Air pollution and cardiovascular disease: Mitochondria may be the missing link
health.summary: Researchers at UCLA Health have discovered new blood biomarkers—long-chain dicarboxylate acids (DCAs) and medium- to long-chain acyl-carnitines (ACs)—linking air pollution to cardiovascular disease. Analyzing samples from mice and humans exposed to air pollution, the study reveals how these biomarkers indicate cellular damage and increased heart disease risk. Findings are published in Arteriosclerosis, Thrombosis, and Vascular Biology.

health.title: Dengue, influenza in circulation; Chennai hospitals see steady rise in fever cases
health.summary: Dengue and influenza viruses are circulating in Chennai, leading to a steady increase in fever cases at local hospitals. Medical professionals report that the number of patients aligns with seasonal trends, though they remain vigilant for potential dengue outbreaks. Hospitals are managing the situation, balancing the rise in cases while monitoring for any warning signs related to dengue.

health.title: Healthy lungs vital for heart, brain and overall well-being: Experts
health.summary: Experts in Nagpur emphasize the critical role of lung health in overall well-being, linking it to heart and brain function. On World Lung Day 2025, they highlighted the risks of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), tuberculosis (TB), cancer, pollution, and smoking. Dr. Sushant Meshram underscored that maintaining healthy lungs is essential for preventing various health issues.

science.title: Human Sperm Is Rewriting DNA Earlier Than We Realized
science.summary: Researchers have found that genetic differences contributing to a child's uniqueness may develop in a father's sperm earlier than previously understood. This reshuffling of DNA occurs before meiosis, the specialized cell division process. The discovery suggests that the timing of genetic changes in sperm is more complex, potentially influencing inheritance patterns and the genetic diversity of offspring.

science.title: Nanomaterials Give Coatings New Functions, but Industrial Hurdles Slow Wider Use
science.summary: A review examines the use of nanomaterials in coatings to enhance wear resistance, reduce biofouling, and create pigment-free colors. It highlights the distinction between commercially available diamond-wear coatings and unvalidated self-polishing antifouling paints. Key barriers to broader adoption include production consistency, durability, safety, and cost, which hinder the implementation of advanced nanoscale designs in various applications.

entertainment.title: 'Hanuman Ansh' box office collection day 49: Vishal Chaturvedi's film mints Rs 3.65 cr on Thursday; India net reaches Rs 288.33 cr; worldwide gross at Rs 377.05 cr
entertainment.summary: Vishal Chaturvedi's film 'Hanuman Ansh' earned Rs 3.65 crore in India on Day 49, bringing its total net collection to Rs 288.33 crore. The film has grossed Rs 377.05 crore worldwide. The collection was recorded across 6,729 shows on September 24, reflecting a 2.7% decrease compared to the previous day, according to Sacnilk.

entertainment.title: Aries Horoscope Today: September 25, 2026
entertainment.summary: Aries should pay attention to their health and emotional responses to people, situations, and environments. It is advised to be mindful of feelings that arise, particularly when hands feel unclean despite not touching anything. A practical tip is to wash hands regularly to cleanse negative energy. Staying aware of these sensations can help maintain overall well-being.

entertainment.title: Capricorn Horoscope Today: September 25, 2026
entertainment.summary: Capricorns are advised to stay alert and aware of their surroundings on September 25, 2026. While it's important to recognize potential threats, maintaining a pessimistic outlook can be detrimental. Instead, individuals are encouraged to balance their vigilance with a more positive perspective. Embracing guidance from supportive influences may help in navigating challenges more effectively.
